breakdown.description: Differential pressure is 20% of static, implying high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to address that the high pressure differential implies non-negligible compressibility effects. The ground truth corrects this by asking for compressible isentropic relations. The agent, however, instructs the user to proceed with an incompressible model, failing to fix the inconsistency.

breakdown.description: Incompressible Bernoulli underestimates velocity at higher Mach numbers
breakdown.reason: The agent explicitly repeated the user's incorrect instruction to use the incompressible Bernoulli relation. The ground truth correctly identifies this as the wrong approach for the given physical parameters and asks for compressible relations instead. The agent failed to make this crucial correction.
